''See also: [[Uncrowned King Tournament Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Uncrowned King]] [[tournament]] is a prestigious global competition organized by the world's [[Monarch factions]] to showcase and cultivate their next generation of leaders. Originally established following the [[Dread War]] by surviving [[Monarchs]] to pool resources and raise new talent, the event serves as an exhibition of future military strength. Participation is open to young disciples from [[Monarch]] clans, vassal states, and various territories; for some, it serves as a test of worthiness to join powerful empires. The [[tournament]] is designed to identify individuals with the potential to become future [[Sages]], [[Heralds]], or even ascend to the heavens. Competitors must be under thirty-five years of age, and younger participants often receive more favorable recognition. There are strict power level restrictions: contestants must be at least [[Underlord|Underlords]] but cannot exceed the rank of Overlord. The competition involves multiple rounds of elimination, eventually narrowing down to a top eight. Those who reach this elite group are honored as [[Uncrowned]] and receive the [[Broken Crown]], a unique divine treasure implanted into their souls that serves as an eternal, unremovable mark of their status and strength. Winners also receive significant rewards, such as personal instruction from a [[Sage]], specialized weapons, or gifts from participating teams. The [[tournament]] is a major cultural event, with its matches and results broadcast widely across the world.}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Preparations are currently underway for the eighteenth [[Uncrowned King]] [[tournament]], an upcoming competition scheduled to begin in fourteen months. The [[Blackflame Empire]] may seek to participate in this event, which serves as a way to find competitors. While performing well can guarantee a spot in the [[tournament]], its top four finishers often ascend to the ranks of [[Sages]] or [[Heralds]]. [[Mercy]], who spent much of the previous [[tournament]] on the head family's floating platform, intends to lead a team in this next iteration.}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The eighteenth [[Uncrowned King]] [[tournament]], held three years after Luminous Queen Sha Leiala{{!}}Sha Leiala's battle with plague-spirits, serves as a massive global event organized by two surviving [[Monarchs]] and [[Heralds]] to pool resources and cultivate new [[Monarchs]]. Designed as an exhibition of future military power, the competition features young [[Lords]] and [[Ladies]] serving their clans, including [[Lindon]] as a representative of the [[Akura clan|Akura family]]. As the [[tournament]] progresses into its fourth round, participants like [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] face opponents of various [[aspects]]. During the matches, competitors are re-formed just one hour after being killed.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Uncrowned King]] [[tournament]] is a high-level competition involving [[Monarchs]] and other powerful competitors, where the eventual winner determines the [[Fate|fate]] of the [[Blackflame Empire]]. Although the schedule was altered and an age limit of thirty-five was established, the event featured notable fighters such as [[Yan Shoumei]], [[Blacksword]], and [[Therian Nills]]. Participants earned points to purchase prizes, and [[Divine Treasure|Divine Treasures]] were revealed publicly to prevent imbalance during the final round. Following a rule that prevented anyone from advancing past the Overlord stage, [[Yerin]] reached the top four and ultimately became the champion after defeating [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]] in the fifth and final fight of the last round. While [[Lindon]] failed to pay sufficient attention to the event, recordings of the [[tournament]] were later made available to [[Yerin]] by [[Charity]].}}
